Run over-representation analysis (ORA)

Source: R/analysis_enrich.R
run_ora.Rd

Run over-representation analysis (ORA)

Usage

run_ora(
  genes,
  organism,
  db = c("GO", "KEGG", "Reactome"),
  ont = c("BP", "MF", "CC"),
  universe = NULL,
  padj_cutoff = 0.05,
  min_size = 10,
  max_size = 500
)

Arguments

genes

character vector of significant gene symbols

organism

one of "human", "mouse", "rat"

db

database: "GO", "KEGG", or "Reactome"

ont

GO ontology when db == "GO": "BP", "MF", or "CC"

universe

optional background gene symbols (converted to ENTREZ)

padj_cutoff

adjusted p-value cutoff passed to clusterProfiler

min_size, max_size

gene-set size filters

Value

a tidy data.frame with columns: ID, Description, GeneRatio, BgRatio, pvalue, padj, qvalue, Count, geneID (possibly zero rows)
